bullets.text: Duos Technologies Enhances Edge AI - **Duos Technologies** is revolutionising edge computing by deploying modular data centres in underserved markets.
AI Supercycle Drives Urgent Planning - The current **AI supercycle** demands rapid planning amidst unprecedented market changes and supply shortages.
KT Launches Sovereign AI Server - **KT** unveils the NPU LLM Station, a fully on-premise AI server tailored for sensitive sectors.
EE's Fast Lane 5G Service - **EE** introduces a premium network slicing service to enhance mobile performance during peak times.
Lightyear Launches Dispatch AI - **Lightyear** introduces Dispatch, an AI platform that automates telecom quoting and implementation processes.
